title: Russian Rice Stick Noodles
description: A quick-fix Russian dish featuring fermented rice stick noodles with a shio-cure, jain-friendly seasoning blend, this lightly fermented noodle dish is perfect for a weeknight lunch. It is crumbly and full of flavor.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the rice stick noodles to the boiling water and cook for 3-5 minutes, or until they are slightly tender.
Drain the noodles and rinse them with cold water to stop the cooking process.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio-cure seasoning, salt, sugar, and black pepper.
In a large pan, melt the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the vegan butter.
Sprinkle the shio-cure seasoning mixture over the noodles and stir to combine.
Cook the noodles for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they are lightly fermented and crumbly.
